The fix changes the matched objects of 0 captions in total, which supports the scorer's statement that the fixed captions name the same objects. So R14 excludes nothing, and with A2 (0 provenance deviations) the empty excluded_runs ({}) and kill_rules.KD_CC-033b_and_R14_exclusions ({}) are the correct result. Not a KD condition (prereg: 'slice 0 ... the identical-caption count is recorded (no gate)'): parity_slice0 is all-identical in 4 of 16 runs.

D1.evidence: Rule lines applied (prereg): LBB-P1 "`tau_b(CIDEr_as_written(ZS), CIDEr_fix(ZS))` on the full KTVIC test set, tau_lt (tau0 1: at least 1 discordant pair of 6 (no ties)); ZS = the B-N1 zero-shot models"; tau_lt: "PASS if ci95_hi < tau0; FAIL if point >= tau0; else INCONCLUSIVE"; tau0 = 1. The verdict function is built by parsing these strings, not typed. Statistic in the output: tau_b = 1.000, 95% CI [1.000, 1.000], 4 models. ci95_hi 1 < tau0 1? no; point 1 >= tau0? yes -> FAIL (output: FAIL). Reading: with 4 models, tau_b = 1 with no ties means 0 discordant pairs of 6 (independent count from the leaderboard CIDEr-D values: 0), and the CI is the single point on all 1000 shared draws, so the punctuation fix leaves the 4-model ranking unchanged on KTVIC test (short prompt): order by CIDEr-D, as written and fix alike: internvl3_8b > qwen25vl_7b > qwen3vl_8b > qwen25vl_3b (equal: True). The fix raises every model's CIDEr-D (x100): as written [17.47, 27.64, 24.314, 34.024], fix [20.548, 31.584, 28.508, 39.331] in the prereg model order ['qwen25vl_3b', 'qwen25vl_7b', 'qwen3vl_8b', 'internvl3_8b']; the smallest gap between adjacent models is 3.326 (as written) and 3.075 (fix). Main's reading is confirmed: LBB-P1 FAIL.

D2.evidence: Rule lines applied: LBB-P2 "`tau_b(CIDEr_fix(ZS) on the full ktvic_test, CIDEr_fix(ZS) on uitviic_test)` tau_ge (tau0 0.6: at most 1 discordant pair of 6 (no ties))"; tau_ge: "PASS if ci95_lo >= tau0; FAIL if point < tau0; else INCONCLUSIVE"; tau0 = 0.6. Statistic: tau_b(KTVIC fix, UIT-ViIC fix) = 0.667, 95% CI [0.333, 0.667], 4 models. ci95_lo 0.333 >= tau0 0.6? no; point 0.667 < tau0? no -> INCONCLUSIVE (output: INCONCLUSIVE). The point is the registered 'at most 1 discordant pair of 6': independent count 1; the discordant pair is [['qwen25vl_7b', 'qwen3vl_8b']] (order on KTVIC internvl3_8b > qwen25vl_7b > qwen3vl_8b > qwen25vl_3b; on UIT-ViIC internvl3_8b > qwen3vl_8b > qwen25vl_7b > qwen25vl_3b). Under the prereg 'counting' rule, "Kill rules count FAIL only." INCONCLUSIVE is neither support nor a kill: KB2 does not fire. Main's reading is confirmed.

D3.evidence: Rule lines applied: LBB-P3 "`tau_b(fix) - tau_b(as written)` (the LBB-P2 statistic minus its as-written twin) sign_gt_0"; sign_gt_0: "PASS if ci95_lo > 0; FAIL if point <= 0; else INCONCLUSIVE". Statistic: tau_b(fix) - tau_b(as written) = 0.000, 95% CI [-0.333, 0.000], 4 models. ci95_lo -0.333 > 0? no; point 0 <= 0? yes -> FAIL (output: FAIL) through the 'point <= 0' clause, not through a significantly negative difference (ci95_hi = 0). The fix and as-written twins have the same discordant pair: as written 1 discordant pair(s) [['qwen25vl_7b', 'qwen3vl_8b']] -> tau_b 0.667, fix 1 -> 0.667; their difference is exactly 0 in float (both are 4/6 from the same arithmetic). Main's reading is confirmed. LBB-P3 is a registered secondary with no kill rule.

D4.evidence: Kill rules applied: KB1 when "LBB-P1 is FAIL"; KB2 when "LBB-P2 is FAIL"; KM when "a model has a run missing or excluded by KD on a set" then "the model leaves every tau on that set; a tau with fewer than 4 models is NOT_EVALUABLE"; KD when "a run whose provenance differs from this registration (model file, prompt, decoding, batch size, package version)"; counting: "Kill rules count FAIL only." KB1: LBB-P1 is FAIL -> fires (recomputed True, output True); consequence: "Paper B does not claim that the fix re-ranks public zero-shot systems; it reports the shifts only". KB2: LBB-P2 is INCONCLUSIVE, not FAIL -> does not fire (recomputed False, output False). KM: no run is missing or excluded (A1-A3), so every model keeps its place on both sets: KM_models_kept = {'ktvic_test': ['qwen25vl_3b', 'qwen25vl_7b', 'qwen3vl_8b', 'internvl3_8b'], 'uitviic_test': ['qwen25vl_3b', 'qwen25vl_7b', 'qwen3vl_8b', 'internvl3_8b']}, kill_rules.KM = {'ktvic_test': [], 'uitviic_test': []}; each tau has 4 models and the NOT_EVALUABLE threshold is fewer than 4, so all three are evaluable. KD/R14: exclusions in the output {'excluded_runs': {}, 'KD_CC-033b_and_R14_exclusions': {}}, as A2 and A3 find independently. Main's reading is confirmed.

D5.evidence: Extra, not requested: the three point estimates re-derived from the output's own leaderboard (LBB-D2) CIDEr-D values of the 4 short zero-shot runs with my own tau-b pair count and scipy.stats.kendalltau(variant='b'): LBB-P1 1.000000, LBB-P2 0.666667, LBB-P3 0.000000; max |difference| to the output 2.2e-16; ties in the four vectors: False. The bootstrap CIs need the per-image vectors, which the output does not store; they are reproduced by C1 (same code, same data, same draws), not by an independent re-implementation.

notes_for_writer: Reporting (prereg section 9): every verdict is quoted as computed with the protocol card (RDRSegmenter word level, CIDEr-D x100, punctuation variant). KB1 fires: Paper B does not claim that the punctuation fix re-ranks public zero-shot systems; it reports the shifts only (the fix raises every model's CIDEr-D but leaves the 4-model order unchanged on KTVIC test, short prompt). LBB-P2 is INCONCLUSIVE, which the 'counting' rule says is reported as inconclusive and never as support, so Paper B may not write that KTVIC rankings transfer to UIT-ViIC; report the discordant pair. LBB-P3 FAIL: the fix does not raise cross-benchmark agreement here (difference exactly 0.0; the same single pair is discordant as written and with the fix).

Exposure labels (prereg section 9): KTVIC leaked/clean by OpenViIC train copy; UIT-ViIC test = COCO train2014 images. The models' training data are not verified by this registration; LBB-S1 (clean 157) and the language-guard clean intersection are sensitivity analyses without verdicts and change no verdict.

Disclose (registered descriptive items, LBB-D2): hit_max share (captions that ran to the new-token limit) is qwen25vl_3b_uitviic_test-short 0.268, qwen25vl_3b_uitviic_test-detailed 0.286, qwen25vl_7b_ktvic_test-detailed 0.534, qwen25vl_7b_uitviic_test-detailed 0.429, qwen3vl_8b_ktvic_test-detailed 1.000, qwen3vl_8b_uitviic_test-detailed 0.991, internvl3_8b_ktvic_test-detailed 0.590, internvl3_8b_uitviic_test-detailed 0.290 (runs at or above 0.25); parity_slice0 (slice 0 at the registered batch size vs batch size 1) is all-identical in only 4 of 16 runs; the prereg records it with no gate, so it is not a KD condition, but it shows batch-size sensitivity of greedy bf16 decodes.

This record does not re-verify the scorer's design choices already ruled (CC-039 R1-R15, CP-039 (2)); it checks that the scorer as committed ran on the registered inputs, that its output reproduces byte for byte, and that the verdicts follow from the prereg rule text. The bootstrap CIs were not re-derived by an independent implementation (see D5).
